statutes.title: Illinois Individual Income Tax Rate
text_en: Constitutionally mandated non-graduated flat income tax rate of 4.95% on net income of individuals, trusts, and estates.
text_es: Impuesto estatal no graduado a tasa fija del 4.95% sobre el ingreso neto de personas naturales, mandatado por la Constitución de Illinois.

statutes.title: Definition of Resident
text_en: Defines resident as an individual who is in Illinois for other than a temporary or transitory purpose during the taxable year or who is domiciled in Illinois.
text_es: Define residente como persona en Illinois para fines no transitorios o temporales, o domiciliada en Illinois ausente temporalmente.

statutes.title: Compensation and Nonresident Income Sourcing
text_en: Rules for allocating and sourcing compensation and business income of nonresidents based on physical days of services performed within Illinois.
text_es: Reglas de asignación de ingresos y salarios de no residentes a Illinois basándose en servicios efectivamente prestados en el estado.
